item.title: Adjusting the Time-To-Live (TTL) in DynamicDNS (os-ddclient) Configuration in OPNsense
item.description: Unfortunately, in OPNsense, it is not possible to set the TTL (Time to Live) for Dynamic DNS, which means DNS entries always have a TTL of 10800 seconds or 3 hours. This limitation undermines the purpose of Dynamic DNS, in my opinion.
